::: {.why}
Every strategy you build this year will notionally trade at the close, so it is worth knowing that the close is not a trade at all but a single-price auction with its own participants and its own deadlines.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Describe how a closing auction sets one price, and say what an imbalance message tells you and when it starts being published.
- Say why a large index fund trades in the auction rather than during the day, and what that does to your fill if you join them.
